infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sanjivini requires your location to pinpoint your emergency coordinates and dispatch rescue services accurately.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sanjivini requires camera access to attach real-time photo evidence of the disaster scenario to your emergency report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sanjivini requires photo library access to upload disaster evidence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Sanjivini to use your location for emergency dispatch.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sanjivini to access camera for incident reporting.
